faceDesign.why: 작은 여우형 얼굴과 목의 풍성한 털을 작은 턱과 부드러운 볼로 해석한다.

scene: Taking a small step through an empty lantern-festival courtyard at blue dusk, gently carrying one unlettered amber paper lantern by its simple handle with one hand, other hand open and separate. Head through knees, both complete hands clear; softly glowing lantern strings and cobblestones, no crowd.
outfit: Opaque chocolate one-shoulder fitted top, high-waisted cream A-line miniskirt over fully covering brown shorts, tan ankle sandals and tiny cream feather earrings. Bare shoulder, arms and legs, chest and pelvis covered; original festival fashion without armor.
custom: 1024x1536 vertical. Preserve the approved adult face and haircut. No large ear headpieces, armor, tail sash or creature costume: retain only tiny cream feather earrings as the motif. Frame from the complete head to just above the knees, both hands fully visible, no feet in this knee-up composition. Both complete hands visibly connect to their respective forearms, with one thumb and four separate natural fingers each. No weapons, text, logos or extra figures.
